output.reason: The brief fits the evidence I can see: night receiving was cut in week 31, probes are taken at receipt confirmation, which can be well after unloading, and Haverlow's dispatch temperatures haven't changed. Its additional data (dock-to-chamber times, trailer temperatures at door opening, write-offs up for every supplier on nights only) points clearly to the DC's own staffing cut rather than Haverlow, and it says plainly what to do while keeping the Corriebank credits question open.
